originalQuestion: Where did the centers with no receipts go?
clarifiedQuestion: For each listed distribution center, how many inventory units were stocked during November 2025 UTC? Include centers with zero receipts.
humanResponse:
Keep the receipt window in the join condition so every center survives the join. Count matched inventory IDs to give an empty center a count of zero.

```sql
SELECT d.id AS center_id, d.name AS center_name, COUNT(i.id) AS units_received
FROM `tv_thelook.distribution_centers` AS d
LEFT JOIN `tv_thelook.inventory_items` AS i
  ON i.product_distribution_center_id = d.id
 AND i.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00 UTC'
 AND i.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00 UTC'
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
ORDER BY units_received DESC, center_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
```
